name: TypeScript dashboard
description: A small TypeScript widget module with an unsanitized innerHTML sink, disabled TLS verification and a hard-coded API key. Intentionally insecure, for education.
expected: Findings from the JavaScript/TypeScript token scanner.

fixes.title: Read the API key from the environment
fixes.explanation: The key is no longer in the repository (rotate the exposed one).

fixes.title: Write text instead of HTML
fixes.explanation: textContent never interprets markup, so the comment cannot inject script.
